jobs.title: Innosight Consulting Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Innosight is a global strategy consulting firm focused on helping leading organizations design and create the future. We work with them to develop growth strategies, build innovation capabilities, and accelerate new growth initiatives. As a member of the Innosight team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with leaders at Global 1000 companies to tackle some of the most interesting challenges in business.

• We are the leading practitioners of disruptive innovation, building on the work of our co-founder, Harvard Business School professor Clay Christensen.
• Because we focus on growth strategy and innovation, we bring unique expertise and authority to the challenges our clients face: Where is our next big opportunity, and what is our strategy to get there? How do we build an organization that is innovative and future focused? How do we disrupt ourselves before others do?
• Our values – including humility, collaboration, transparency, and intellectual curiosity – guide our work with clients, with each other, and our commitment to enabling innovation in organizations.
• Our work environment emphasizes the exchange of ideas, continuous learning, and collaboration. And our smaller team structure offers exposure to senior-level executives early in your consulting career.

Innosight is seeking a Senior Associate to join our Strategy & Operations consulting team. Senior Associates play a critical role in driving client impact by owning significant workstreams, leading rigorous analyses, and helping clients solve complex strategic and operational challenges.

Working closely with Managers, Directors, and Partners, you will help organizations translate strategy into measurable business results. Projects may include growth strategy, operational transformation, profitability improvement, performance enhancement, organizational effectiveness, value creation, and business transformation initiatives.

Our work spans a broad range of industries, including industrials, life sciences, aerospace and defense, consumer products, technology, energy, and other sectors. Successful candidates are intellectually curious, analytically rigorous, and comfortable working in fast-paced, client-facing environments where ambiguity and complex problem solving are part of the day-to-day experience.

Key Responsibilities
As a Senior Associate, you will:
- Independently own and manage one or more project workstreams from problem definition through final recommendations.

- Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses, build workplans, and prioritize analyses to drive client outcomes.

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to evaluate business performance, operational effectiveness, growth opportunities, profitability drivers, and organizational capabilities.

- Translate analyses into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready recommendations.

- Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, models, and supporting analyses.

- Facilitate client meetings, workshops, interviews, and working sessions.

- Present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders, including senior executives.

- Manage workstream timelines, risks, and dependencies while ensuring high-quality execution.

- Coach and mentor junior team members by providing guidance, feedback, and quality review of work products.

- Contribute to business development activities, proposal development, thought leadership, and internal firm initiatives.

- Leverage Innosight methodologies and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to enhance analysis, problem solving, and client impact.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 4 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, operational transformation, business transformation, private equity value creation, or related business leadership roles.

- Experience supporting strategic, operational, and value creation initiatives, including growth strategy, corporate strategy, business transformation, operational improvement, organizational effectiveness, supply chain and operations, profitability enhancement, private equity due diligence, complexity reduction, and related business challenges.

- Demonstrated experience owning significant workstreams and delivering results in client-facing environments.

- Strong analytical, quantitative, and structured problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience applying generative AI tools and technologies in consulting, analytical, or business environments to support research, problem solving, analysis, and client impact.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate ambiguous business challenges.

- Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel with the ability to create client-ready deliverables.

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA strongly preferred.

Travel and Location
- Travel requirements vary by project, but candidates must be willing to travel weekly as needed (up to 80%)

- Candidates may live anywhere in the contiguous 48 states near a major airport

The estimated base salary range for this job is $165,000 - $200,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $206,250 - $250,000. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

Healthcare organizations must stay ahead of disruption by making data-driven decisions that accelerate transformation. Innosight thoroughly examines the intricate patient care challenges encountered by payor and provider healthcare entities to stabilize business today and create tomorrow’s growth engine. As trusted strategic partners to CEOs and C-Suites, we help drive the healthcare industry forward by designing innovative enterprise-level long-term plans and partnerships for the world's leading healthcare organizations.

As a Consulting Director on Innosight’s Healthcare Provider Strategy & Innovation team, you will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives and boards of leading healthcare organizations. You will lead complex strategy engagements, develop innovative growth models, and guide clients through market ambiguity to create long-term impact.

This is a high-responsibility, high-impact role for a strategic thinker who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about shaping the future of healthcare.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead Strategic Engagements: Drive multi-workstream projects focused on growth strategy, business model transformation, and innovation.

- Advise Senior Leaders: Provide guidance to CEOs and boards on enterprise-level planning, partnerships, and cultural transformation.

- Develop Insights: Structure problems, formulate hypotheses, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative research into actionable strategies.

- Deliver Impactful Outcomes: Prepare and present high-quality deliverables, ensuring logical flow and clarity.

- Drive Business Development: Collaborate with Managing Directors to identify opportunities and support revenue growth.

- Mentor Talent: Coach and develop junior team members, fostering a culture of excellence and inclusion.

Required Experience:
- Extensive consulting experience and a proven track record of success with a top management consulting firm delivering strategic solutions within the healthcare industry.

- Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level strategic engagements for healthcare provider organizations, including long-term and near-term strategy, growth initiatives, enterprise transformation, market entry, service line strategy, M&A/partnerships, and margin or cost optimization.

- Expert-level knowledge of the healthcare provider industry, including experience working with diverse provider organizations such as Hospital Systems, Academic Medical Centers, Ambulatory Surgery Centers, Integrated Delivery Networks, Physician Practices/Groups, etc.

- Conceptual, Strategic and Problem-Solving Skills: Able to integrate diverse information, think strategically, and apply large-scale data and analytics. Strong quantitative and business analysis acumen; effective in making high-quality decisions and taking decisive action.

- Exceptional Engagement Delivery: Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, generate clear work plans, and lead junior employees. Successfully execute across multiple projects while delivery high-quality work to the client.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional communicator skilled at crafting clear, high-impact presentations, proposals, and workshops; able to guide teams in visualizing complex information and insights.

- Talent Development Capability: Demonstrated ability to attract, evaluate, coach, and advance talented people. Values diversity and has a strong desire to build a high-performing, mission-driven team.

- Values and Vision: Embodies core values of simplicity, openness, integration, and mission-driven work. Demonstrates strong ethics, commitment to diversity, customer/market focus, and consistent modeling of desired behaviors with presence and humility.

- Travel and Home Office: Travel requirements vary by project, but candidates must be willing to travel weekly as needed. You may live anywhere in the contiguous 48 states near a major airport.

jobs.description:

We work with them to develop growth strategies, build innovation capabilities, and accelerate new growth initiatives. As a member of the Innosight team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with leaders at Global 1000 companies to tackle some of the most interesting challenges in business.

• We are the leading practitioners of disruptive innovation, building on the work of our co-founder, Harvard Business School professor Clay Christensen.
• Because we focus on growth strategy and innovation, we bring unique expertise and authority to the challenges our clients face: Where is our next big opportunity, and what is our strategy to get there? How do we build an organization that is innovative and future focused? How do we disrupt ourselves before others do?
• Our values – including humility, collaboration, transparency, and intellectual curiosity – guide our work with clients, with each other, and our commitment to enabling innovation in organizations.
• Our work environment emphasizes the exchange of ideas, continuous learning, and collaboration. And our smaller team structure offers exposure to senior-level executives early in your consulting career.

We are seeking a High Reliability & Operational Transformation Consultant to join Innosight and help deliver High Reliability and Human Performance engagements that enable organizations to improve execution, reduce operational risk, strengthen culture, and build resilient operating systems in increasingly complex environments. The Consultant will also contribute to a broader range of strategy, operations, organizational transformation, and performance improvement engagements.

Our work draws on principles from High Reliability Organizations (HROs), Human and Organizational Performance (H&OP), Operational Excellence, and Complexity Management. We help clients across manufacturing, oil and gas, energy, chemicals, utilities, defense, transportation, and industrial services operate more safely, reliably, and effectively while improving business performance. Organizations that successfully navigate complexity are better positioned to execute strategy, manage risk, and sustain superior operational results.

This role combines strategy, operations, organizational transformation, and hands-on implementation. Consultants work directly with executives, operational leaders, frontline supervisors, and client teams to diagnose challenges, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions that create measurable business impact.

What You’ll Do:

Improve Reliability, Safety, and Performance
- Assess operational performance, organizational culture, and management systems.

- Evaluate reliability, safety, quality, and execution risks across complex operations.

- Support High Reliability Organization transformations.

- Apply Human and Organizational Performance principles to improve resilience and reduce the likelihood and impact of failures.

- Facilitate operational and cultural diagnostics, workshops, interviews, and site assessments.

- Conduct root-cause analyses and identify systemic barriers to sustained performance.

Execute Organizational Transformation
- Help clients understand and address complexity that impedes operational effectiveness.

- Support the design and implementation of Integrated Management Systems.

- Strengthen leadership effectiveness, accountability, decision-making, and organizational alignment.

- Support operating model redesign and execution excellence initiatives.

- Conduct culture assessments and support programs that enable sustainable behavioral change.

- Partner with client teams to design, implement, and sustain practical improvements.

Deliver Measurable Business Results
- Identify opportunities to reduce operational risk and improve reliability.

- Improve asset utilization, maintenance effectiveness, and operational discipline.

- Strengthen organizational learning and continuous improvement capabilities.

- Improve workforce engagement, coordination, and communication.

- Support business transformation, operational excellence, and performance improvement initiatives.

- Translate operational findings into practical recommendations and implementation plans.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, advanced degree, or relevant advanced military training preferred.

- 5+ years of experience in operational excellence, military operations, manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, consulting, or a related field.

- Experience leading or supporting operational improvement, culture transformation, organizational change, performance improvement, or operational excellence initiatives.

- Experience working in a complex, highly regulated, high-risk, or high-consequence operating environment.

- Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

- Ability to build credibility and work effectively with frontline personnel, operational leaders, and senior executives.

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, dynamic, and team-oriented client environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in military leadership, nuclear or aviation operations, manufacturing, industrial operations, reliability, maintenance, engineering, or another complex, high-consequence operating environment.

Relevant professional experience may include:
- Military leadership experience in technically complex, high-risk, or high-consequence operating environments, including the U.S. Navy Nuclear Program, submarine or surface warfare, naval aviation, Special Operations, Army or Marine Corps combat arms, logistics, engineering, maintenance, or other operational communities.

- Manufacturing, refining, petrochemicals, energy, utilities, mining, transportation, or other industrial operations

- Plant management, operations management, maintenance, reliability, production, process engineering, or operational excellence

- Consulting focused on operational transformation, performance improvement, culture change, organizational effectiveness, or execution excellence

- Travel requirements vary by project, but candidates must be willing to travel weekly as needed up to 80% (Monday - Thursday)

- Candidates may live anywhere in the contiguous 48 states near a major airport
